headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 12, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a thrilling comeback against the Milwaukee Brewers, edging out their opponents 7-6 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs. In other news, the Los Angeles Angels fell short in Minnesota, dropping a 3-5 decision to the Twins. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation. Other players affected by injuries include Chris Martin of the Texas Rangers, Nick Lodolo of the Cincinnati Reds, William Kempner of the Miami Marlins, Brandon Woodruff of the Milwaukee Brewers, Mike Yastrzemski of the Atlanta Braves, Anthony Banda of the Minnesota Twins, and Nick Kurtz of the Athletics.

The Milwaukee Brewers bolstered their infield with the acquisition of shortstop Braden Shewmake in a trade with the Houston Astros. The Chicago White Sox also made a trade, sending LHP Brandon Eisert and 1B Jacob Gonzalez to the Pittsburgh Pirates in exchange for LHP Jaden Woods and future considerations.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Thrilling Comeback**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 7-6 in a closely contested game. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a grand slam and 6 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Brewers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates edged out the Milwaukee Brewers 3-2 in a closely contested matchup. Esmerlyn Valdez led the Brewers' offense with a home run and two RBIs, but it wasn't enough to overcome the Pirates' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Angels Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Angels dropped a 3-5 decision to the Minnesota Twins, ending their game on a losing note. Royce Lewis led the Twins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, while Joe Ryan pitched 6 strong innings for the Twins.

top_news.title: **Athletics Fall Short in Chicago**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox edged the Athletics 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Meidroth led the Athletics with 2 hits, 1 RBI, and a key double that scored a run.

top_news.title: **Gallen Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Zac Gallen has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow inflammation, effective retroactive to July 9, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Shewmake Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have added shortstop Braden Shewmake to their roster, acquired in a trade from the Houston Astros. Shewmake joins the Brewers' infield, bolstering the team's lineup.
